scope: Only planning documents and docs/post-mvp/mockups; no application verification or release gate run.

checks.description: 19 primary views × 4 sizes × normal and warnings states, with 23 synthetic students.

interactions.observed: The complete CVC symbol is visible. Selecting Cabinato then level 4 updates the preview to C4 - 35 | 2026; bottom navigation remains hidden.
Five 40px controls remain inside each card at 430/412/390; at 320 they move below the name.
Filling the missing birth date changes missing fields 1 to 0 and inserted students 2 to 3 in the sticky summary.
Add volunteer opens with an empty name and ADV selected by default.
Warning scenario shows 20/21 unique students in a yellow sticky status; normal scenario is neutral when complete.
Crew 1 displays two XL students and its warning detail states the crew-size reason independently from boat faults.
Seven session boats fit in a sticky internal scroller; reading cards separate crew number, boat logo/number, and names.
First tap selects one of five values; tapping the selected value again changes aria-pressed back to false.
Missing evaluations render as blank cells; positive/negative colors are reserved; P19 final seven-day AM/PM grid is fully visible without page overflow.

limitations: Measurements describe synthetic layouts and primary interactive states, not every production state.
No physical-device, 200% text, contrast certification or production accessibility claim.
P17 deliberately uses more vertical space to keep full names and five direct evaluation controls visible.
P15 internal horizontal strip and P04/P19 content choices await Q11-Q13.
No persistence, OCR accuracy, voice latency or cross-session integrity verification.
Human approval is still required before any design becomes an implementation target.
